The Petition seeks an order (i) directing the Issuer to convene a special general meeting to vote on the proposals set forth in the Demand Letter, or, alternatively, at least on the proposed removal of directors, with the Court determining how any resulting vacancies are to be filled; (ii) restricting the Issuer, until such meeting, from taking actions outside the ordinary course of business, including issuing securities (such as under its agreement with YA II PN, Ltd.), and from appointing additional directors; and (iii) requiring the Issuer to pay S.H.N.'s expenses in connection with the Petition, including attorneys' fees.

stakes.purpose: Item 4 is hereby amended to add the following: On October 30, 2026, the Reporting Person delivered a letter (the "Letter") to the Issuer's board of directors (the "Board") including a non-binding proposal for the Reporting Person to acquire all of the outstanding Shares of the Issuer in a take-private transaction. Based on the Reporting Person's review of publicly available information, the Reporting Person expressed its willingness to propose an acquisition price in the range of $5.61 to $7.00 per share in cash, which is at least 50% above the closing price of $3.74 on October 29, 2026. The Reporting Person stated that it is open to allowing other shareholders to participate in a transaction alongside the Reporting Person, with the Reporting Person acquiring the majority interest, with the scope of such participation determined through the Board's strategic process. The Reporting Person noted that ultimately it would seek a waiver of the Issuer's Stockholder Rights Agreement, dated October 12, 2026, so it is able to work with other interested shareholders. The Reporting Person highlighted its prior engagement with the Board and intention to continue to work together in a constructive manner toward an outcome that is in the best interests of all shareholders and other stakeholders, and the Reporting Person's track record delivering substantial value at other portfolio companies. A copy of the Letter is attached hereto as Exhibit 99.1 and incorporated herein by reference.
